issues.detail: The file contains extensive explanatory text that may be considered padded, reducing conciseness.
The instructions include platform-specific commands and lack full coverage for all platforms, reducing cross-platform compatibility.

scenarios.name: sync-with-backup-and-filter
scenarios.rationale: Response B provides the required rclone sync command with all flags, while Response A uses aws s3 commands and does not meet the rubric.

scenarios.name: serve-google-drive-readonly
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully matches the rubric, while Response B uses the incorrect flag --password instead of --pass.

scenarios.name: encrypt-and-upload-backblaze
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required obscure password syntax but adds extra flags to the copy command, while Response B omits the obscure syntax entirely and also adds flags.
